title: 1am posting about sherie rene scott because I must #thequeenofversail...
transcript: I saw the Queen of Versailles tonight and I cried in like the first three minutes of the show. and It's because the audience was so enthusiastic. Sherie Rene Scott's debut as Jackie Siegel in The Queen of Versailles, and everybody in that audience was a Sherie Rene Scott super fan. I mean, as they should be, myself included. When I tell you it was an electric feeling. howls and hoots and cheers, and it lasted the entire show, people were so in it. I just kept thinking about the cast. The actors in the show are giving everything they have to the show. And yesterday they got horrible news that their show is closing. They found out the week of Thanksgiving, right before Christmas. They're getting through the holidays and then they're all gonna be out of a job. I do not work in theatre, but I have been laid off in December, and it is not a good feeling. I just kept thinking about these performers who put so much into this show, getting this energy that they so deserved. I hope it made them feel better. I hope they felt that love and the support from the audience. It's the energy that they should be getting every single night. And Sherie was unbelievable Obviously can not expressed to you how good she was. She plays vapid and terrible and reality star better than anyone I've ever seen. Her voice is insane. Performance is just magnetic. She's Got two more shows on the books, both on December 3rd. You gotta see her. but even if you don't, if you go see Queen of versailles between now and January 4th, bring this cast your energy and your support and your love. They're giving you so much, and you should give it right back. Just energy trade. They all deserve it. I just love a special, Broadway Night and the crowds tonight was crazy. so many big people were there, and that was really fun to also just be around. Sherie is amazing. I can't believe she's only doing one more day. Two more shows, so go see her if you can.
reasoning: Creator saw the show, raves about Sherie Rene Scott's performance ('unbelievable', 'magnetic'), and explicitly urges viewers to see it before it closes. Clear strong recommendation despite focus on the closing news.
keyQuote: Sherie was unbelievable... Her voice is insane. Performance is just magnetic... You gotta see her.
